If it were priced the estimate revision breadth would be positive, the FY comp guide would already be treated as stale, and the stock would not be sitting 5.8% above its 52-week low with a +3.0% 20-day run-up a month after Ruger disclosed +19% retail sell-through. On top of that, no US outdoor peer has yet reported this window: Academy does not report fiscal Q2 until 9 September 2026 (https://investors.academy.com/news-releases/news-release-details/academy-sports-outdoors-announces-second-quarter-fiscal-2026), so SPWH prints first and there is no peer datapoint in the tape.
